---
title: Highlight lines with annotations
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'annotations: \("1": 1, "3": 2\)'
        -
          - 'quarto-code-annotations:'
          - '# <'
---

```{.python code-line-numbers="|1,3|2"}
a = 1  # <1>
b = 2
c = 3  # <2>
```

1. One.
2. Three.
